James Dean
Preserved Primary Document • dean-j5.htm
James Dean was born in Kent Co., DE in
1825
. Although he does not appear with his family in the
1850
Kent County, DE census records, he was the son of  William Dean  and his wife,  (Mary) Ann Cork  according to his death record.
Wayne, MI Death Record Book 18, p. 185, record 86
James Dean, male, black, married, 76y 4m 29d, Huron {MI}, Clot on
brain; {born} DE- Farmer - {parents} Wm. Dean and Ann Cork, New Boston-
Recorded
4 February 1902
James married  Angelica  (last name unknown) while both were still living in Delaware. Angelica was born in DE on March 1,
1825
according to her grave marker in Romulus, MI. They appear in the
1850
Appoquinimink Hundred, New Castle Co., DE census records. By
1860
the family is living in Romulus Twp., Wayne Co., MI according to the
1860
Census Records.
Children of James and Angelica Dean were :
Mary A. Dean   (b.
1847
in DE)
Ann Dean  (b.
1850
in DE)
Ann does not appear in the
1860
MI census so it is possible she died young
Robert J. Dean  (b. August
1850
in DE- d. July 16,
1874
in MI)
He married Amanda MILLER on August 20,
1872
in Van Buren Twp., Wayne, MI.
Amanda was born in Delaware in
1854
William T. Dean  (b.
1854
in DE - d.
1940
in Romulus Twp, Wayne, MI)
He married Josephine (
1866
-
1917
). Both are buried in Romulus, MI.
Goldsmith Dean  (b.c.
1861
)
James D. Dean  (b.c.
1862
)
James Dean died in Huron Twp., MI on January 18,
1902
. Angelica died on May 20,
1915
.
Both are buried in Romulus, MI.
